title: Paramita of Ethical Conduct: Metta
speaker: Myoki Raizelah Bayen
summary: Myoki Raizelah Bayen invites listeners to approach their spiritual practice with an open and beginner's mind, recognizing that growth and learning are always possible regardless of one's level of experience. This mindset can be cultivated through practices such as metta (loving-kindness meditation), which involves sending kindness and compassion to oneself and others, and Tonglen, a practice that involves breathing in suffering while exhaling love and compassion. By embracing these practices with an open heart and mind, listeners can deepen their understanding of themselves and the world around them, and cultivate greater mindfulness and empathy in the present moment.
